title: Unit Event — From the Marks Left Behind — Episode2 MORE MORE HOUSE Candidates!

meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! starts looking at candidates for their new home base, the MORE MORE HOUSE. However, finding a place that fits their criteria proves rather difficult...

rows.Line: One week later
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This day we've been waiting for... It's finally arrived...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We get to look at prospective properties for the MORE MORE HOUSE!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Woohoo! We get to go house hunting♪>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I'm very much looking forward to seeing what's on the table!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <That Kawanishi person found the places you'll be going to see today, right?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That's right.
Some are newer than others and they're all by different stations, but they all have the things we need.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Plus, they're all within budget.
If we do happen to find the right one, then it'd be great to close the deal.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Umm... I have a question.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ask away, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <So, we all decided to tag along since house hunting sounded like a lot of fun...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <But are you sure we won't be getting in the way? You're essentially choosing the office for your business...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're all more than welcome to be here!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She's right. Once the MORE MORE HOUSE is up and established, we'll get to spend more time with all of you. So, you should all be here for this.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, then... Thank you!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Then, we'll help you inspect each one. We've also become quite good at hiding since you've been nice enough to take us to all those different places.>
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: Ah, you're already here.

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry. Were you having a call?
I can wait until you're finished...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
No, that's okay!
We actually just finished.

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line:
I see.
Then, shall we? Please join me in the car if you're ready to depart.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yikes... That was a close one...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Overconfidence can lead to mistakes, so we need to be as careful as ever.>
A few hours later
Neighborhood

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: Alright, that was the last one on the list.

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: It's unfortunate that none seemed to fit the bill...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I didn't realize choosing a house would be so difficult.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They all seemed really nice on paper.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, but the first one we visited had a huge pillar running through the middle, which would've made streaming a bit of a challenge...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The second one was ninety years old, but the pictures and floor plan made it seem like the perfect choice...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But the real thing told a different story.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That one room in particular...
I became so worried that one of us would fall through the floor during dance practice.

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry...
I was sure it was a good candidate based on the photos that came attached...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
No, we also felt the same way...
It just goes to show how important it is to actually see the real thing for ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But the third one seemed really nice!
It was clean and had the perfect floor plan for us!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, except for that giant hill we'd have to climb every time. That's on top of it being pretty far from the station, so I really don't think it's worth the trouble.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It'd make for a great workout...
But we might regret it when it rains or after a long day at work.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Which would defeat the purpose of it being the MORE MORE HOUSE...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*
No... If it weren't for that hill...!

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line:
I know how you feel...
Very few places are both that nice and reasonably priced. But there's always a catch. In this case, a large hill.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: On second thought, I'm beginning to wonder if we're ever going to find what we want in our price range...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We may want to start thinking about increasing our budget. However, that also means us having to work a little harder...

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: There's actually one more place that suits you nicely on paper...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, there is?!

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: Yes, but I didn't bring it up until now because it's a bit... Special...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Special...?

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line:
Still, it may be worth a look...
There's still the question of whether the property will interest you or not.

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: So, if you'll bear with me for a while longer, I can try asking the landlady to let us visit today. How does that sound?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Then, okay...
We still have some time on our hands, so it'd be nice to shop around a little more.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, we'd love to go!

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: Then, please give me a minute while I try to get a hold of her.
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What do you think is so special about it...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <What if it's haunted?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh! Maybe someone really scary lives right next door!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I don't know about a haunted house, but I think we can handle having a scary person next door!
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line:
Thank you for your patience!
She gave us the green light to visit!

rows.Speaker: Kawanishi
rows.Line: The group before us just finished, so let's start heading over right now!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
We get to see it?!
Thank goodness...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you very much. Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Still, why's it so special...?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (What kind of house is it...?)
